player_prompt.intro: Za ku lura da {N} ɓoyayyun ƙimomi a jere. A kowane mataki rubuta [accept] don zaɓar ƙimar * yanzu, ko [continue] don tsallake shi kuma ku ga na gaba. Idan ba ku taɓa karɓa ba, an tilasta muku ɗaukar ƙimar ƙarshe. Kun ci nasara (sakamako = 1) ** kawai ** idan ƙimar da kuka zaɓa a ƙarshe ita ce mafi girma duka.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dole ne a yi aiki ko dai [accept] ko [continue] .

outcome.summary: Ka yarda da darajar {value} a zana {draw_num}/{N}. Mafi kyawun duka shine {best}. {result}
